question: Article 12 to 35 contained in Part _________ of the Constitution deal with Fundamental Rights.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Part III**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Part III** of the Indian Constitution contains **Articles 12 to 35**, which deal with **Fundamental Rights**.
 
• The Fundamental Rights are essential for the overall development of individuals and are guaranteed by the Constitution to all citizens.
 
• These rights ensure civil liberties so that all Indians can lead their lives in peace and harmony as citizens of India.
 
• They include rights such as the right to equality, the right to freedom, the right against exploitation, the right to freedom of religion, cultural and educational rights, and the right to constitutional remedies.
 
• Part III is often referred to as the cornerstone of the Indian Constitution and is crucial for safeguarding the democratic fabric of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 12** defines the term '**State**' for the purposes of Part III.
 
• **Article 13** declares that** any law in violation of the Fundamental Rights is void**.
 
• Fundamental Rights are justiciable, meaning individuals can approach the courts for enforcement of these rights.
 
• The Constitution provides for the suspension of these rights during emergencies, but certain rights such as the right to life and personal liberty (Article 21) cannot be suspended.
 
• The Fundamental Rights have been amended from time to time to address changing societal needs and interpretations.
